attack_raw:
Thought: The code uses lxml.etree.fromstring to parse XML data without explicitly disabling external entity processing, enabling XXE attacks.
Vulnerability: XML External Entity (XXE)
CWE: CWE-611
Location: upload()
Payload: <?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">]><root><userid>test</userid><password>&xxe;</password></root>
Expected Impact: Exposes sensitive local files to remote attackers via XML processing
Novelty: 3
Novelty Reason: Classic XXE vulnerability in XML parsing without entity restriction

---

Thought: Error messages return raw exception strings to clients, potentially leaking system details.
Vulnerability: Information Exposure
CWE: CWE-209
Location: upload() exception handler
Payload: Any invalid XML input triggering parsing errors
Expected Impact: Reveals stack traces or system-specific error details to attackers
Novelty: 2
Novelty Reason: Common Flask anti-pattern with well-known security implications

---

Thought: XML input is parsed directly from raw request data without schema validation or sanitization.
Vulnerability: Improper Input Validation
CWE: CWE-20
Location: upload()
Payload: Malformed XML with unexpected structure or special characters
Expected Impact: Could trigger denial of service or injection attacks through parser
Novelty: 4
Novelty Reason: Requires specific context of XML processing but common in legacy systems
